Agent Name: InformationExtraction_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to correctly identify the "fifth section alphabetically" under the Federal Rules. In Step 1, the agent searched for "Federal Rules sections" and found only three major rules (Civil, Criminal, Evidence). It incorrectly concluded these were the only sections and tried to proceed with them, failing to realize that the Federal Rules are divided into many more specific articles (e.g., Rules 1, 2, 3, etc., which constitute the "sections" or distinct rule sets alphabetically). The fifth rule alphabetically is Rule 5 (Subpoenas), not Rule 601 (which is in Article VI of the Evidence Rules). By misidentifying the target rule as Rule 601 instead of Rule 5, the agent set the entire subsequent analysis on the wrong path.
